text:
maya_prod: dropped a quick mock — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/usage-billing-compact. Two questions: inline compact stacked area vs donut flyout for token breakdown, and where the invoice CTA should live for org vs project scope. Thoughts?
rachel_design: Stacked area keeps rows compact and aligns with sparklines. Donut is good when user opens a detailed breakdown. My suggestion: default to stacked area, show donut in a detail flyout that includes a textual list.
theo_fe: Agree re: perf. Stacked area can be pure CSS/SVG with minimal rerenders. Donut needs hit-testing and tooltips; harder with virtualized lists. Also recommend fixed-width totals column to avoid layout shifts when toggling denominations (k/M).
sam_a11y: Accessibility: do not rely on color alone. Add patterned fills and text alternatives. For donuts, include a DOM list before the chart for screen readers and provide aria-labels like "Billable tokens: 12.3k (34%)". Ensure focusable legend and keyboard interaction.
dana_pm: On invoice CTA: propose header-level primary export for full PDF (contextual to scope) + per-row quick-preview (summary) only. Full export behind header reduces accidental heavy exports. Also debounce export clicks and show a toast with a link when ready.
jules_research: In usability sessions, users wanted the total upfront and an expand affordance for breakdown. They liked one-line invoice previews inline (date + net). So per-row preview + header export aligns with that.
rachel_design: Microcopy tweak: use "Billable tokens" in headers; change export label to "Export invoice (PDF)" for clarity. Also add hint under denom toggle: "Toggle units: tokens / k / M".
theo_fe: Implementation notes: preview endpoint should be lightweight and cacheable. Full export should trigger async job and return S3 link when ready. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.
sam_a11y: For previews, ensure modal traps focus and Esc dismisses. Announce loading with aria-live="polite".
deploy-bot: Reminder: feature flag "usage-ui-v2" is enabled on staging deploy 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC — wrap experiments in that flag.
maya_prod: Action items: Rachel to upload stacked + donut flyout by Wed, Theo to spike fixed-width totals + denom toggle, Sam to draft a11y checklist, Jules to add quick metric plan (preview clicks, export clicks), Dana to confirm export filename format with legal. Aim for dev spike this week. :rocket:
